paragraphs: Greenspace Health builds software for behavioral health care, organized around measuring how the people in treatment are actually doing. One part handles intake and waitlists and is shaped to an organization's workflow. Another is a stepped-care hub for campuses and workplaces, offering a community immediate access to wellness resources and care options.

Clients complete short assessments every two to four weeks, on a desktop, phone, tablet or in session. Symptoms are visualized so the person can follow their own progress. Providers see the same results, so both sides come to a session with the same picture when discussing treatment decisions. The platforms carry more than 500 evidence-based assessments with automatic data visualizations.

The site says more than 750 organizations use Greenspace for measurement-based care. On data handling, the company states SOC 2 Type II compliance and conformance with HIPAA security protocols. It says all protected health information is stored in the United States. Its company page names Simon Weisz as president and Jesse Hayman as chief growth officer.

quote.text: Every person accessing behavioral health services should receive high quality care that helps them thrive.
